source: Max full-scale study stock snapshot. Every WSK2512 row is reused from shunt_stock_2026-11-15_rerank.json (same pcb bom sourcing, WSK2512 0.2.0). Every WSK2512-LOW (value, code) pair in the library (D and F, 1.0 to 4.9 mohm) is new: pcb bom -f json in scratch copies of the board where the module SHUNT is WSK2512-LOW (dependency 0.2.0). Stock is a sourcing record (pcb bom offers), not a datasheet value.
